title: Daniil's ores
description: This project adds 5 unique ores with different power levels (1.0x to 4.2x iron). Each ore includes full tools, armor, and decorative blocks. Works on NeoForge 1.21.8. (Out of love for users)
body:
# Daniil's Ores [2.0.0] – NEON's Palette Update

**Adds 9 unique ores to your world.**

Each ore has its own strength and rarity.  
All ores are **Ingot based** — mine, smelt, craft.

---

## ⚔️ Ores & Power (compared to Iron)

| Ore          | Power                 | Color                 | Added in |
|--------------|-----------------------|-----------------------|----------|
| Nyxor        | 1.0x                  | Deep purple           | 1.0.0    |
| Lilacore     | 1.5x                  | Pale purple           | 1.0.0    |
| Purpum       | 2.0x                  | Red-purple            | 1.0.0    |
| Amethyne     | 3.5x                  | Amethyst              | 1.0.0    |
| Violette     | 4.2x                  | Bright purple         | 1.0.0    |
| NEON         | 6.7x                  | Black + white outline | 1.5.0    |
| Blue NEON    | **As NEON** (6.7x)     | Blue + white outline  | 2.0.0 🔥 |
| Green NEON   | **As NEON** (6.7x)     | Green + white outline | 2.0.0 🔥 |
| Purple NEON  | **As NEON** (6.7x)     | Purple + white outline| 2.0.0 🔥 |

---

## 🎨 NEON Palette – How to get colored NEON

### Step 1. Get original NEON
Mine and smelt **NEON Ore** → you get **NEON Ingot** (black + white outline, 6.7x power).

### Step 2. Color the ingot
Place **NEON Ingot** in crafting table with any dye:

| Dye       | Result              |
|-----------|---------------------|
| 🔵 Blue   | **Blue NEON Ingot** |
| 🟢 Green  | **Green NEON Ingot**|
| 🟣 Purple | **Purple NEON Ingot**|

### Step 3. Craft colored tools and armor
Use **colored NEON ingots** in normal crafting recipes:

- **Blue NEON Ingot** → **Blue NEON tools** and **Blue NEON armor**.
- **Green NEON Ingot** → **Green NEON tools** and **Green NEON armor**.
- **Purple NEON Ingot** → **Purple NEON tools** and **Purple NEON armor**.

✅ **You craft colored armor and tools directly from colored ingots.**

---

## ✨ Features

- Full tool sets (pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel, hoe)
- Full armor sets (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
- Ore blocks and ingot blocks for building
- All recipes included (smelting, crafting)

---

## 🎯 Why download?

- Real progression from 1.0x to 6.7x iron
- Choose your NEON color (Blue, Green, Purple)
- Lightweight, no extra dependencies
- Works with **NeoForge 1.21.8**

---

## Official Platforms
